evidence.quoted_text: followed by a space (or ends the line), which is why `a:b` parses and `a: b`
evidence.reason: The cited text is still present at the tip and is factually wrong. YAML 1.2.2's ns-plain-char production permits ':' inside a plain scalar only when followed by a plain-safe non-colon character; ns-char excludes line breaks (#xA/#xD), so a colon that ends the line terminates the plain scalar and is then read as a mapping-value indicator. Hence `run: echo static:` is invalid YAML, the same parser-level failure class as the recorded `static: ` incident. The document's own remedy (keep ':' out of unquoted values or quote the whole value) is already correct, but the parenthetical '(or ends the line)' wrongly assures readers a trailing colon is safe, so ordinary doc-correctness defect.
